game.title: Draughts Naija
game.tagline: Hit di bells before dem vanish!

game.howto.1.text: Golden agogo bells dey pop up for screen. Tap or click each one before e vanish.

game.howto.2.text: Hit plenty bells before time finish and you go win. Di target dey for top.

game.howto.3: Hit bells one after di other to build combo and get more points. If you miss, combo go break.

game.howto.4.text: If you dey use keyboard, press Space to hit di oldest bell, and press P if you wan pause.

persona.name: Mama Nkechi

banter.win.0.text: Well done! Your hand quick pass danfo conductor.

banter.win.1: Na so! Come siddon, di jollof don ready.
banter.win.2: Sharp sharp! Di bells dey fear you.
banter.lose.0: No wahala, try again. Even NEPA dey bring light back.
banter.lose.1: Small small, you go get am.

banter.lose.2.text: Calm down. Di bells no go run anywhere.
